name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_cause_effect_valid_vs_invalid_paired_eval
description: Held-out v0.3-lite paired contrast for ordinary physical outcomes versus nonordinary physical outcomes.

items.text: A person squeezes an orange over a cup. Juice falls into the cup.
Someone tears a sheet of paper in half. Two paper pieces remain on the desk.
A person opens an umbrella in the rain. Water lands on the umbrella fabric.
Someone drops a pebble into a pond. Ripples spread across the water.
A person brushes crumbs from a plate. Crumbs fall onto the napkin.
A person squeezes an orange over a cup. The cup fills with dry leaves.
Someone tears a sheet of paper in half. The paper becomes a sealed envelope.
A person opens an umbrella in the rain. The umbrella fabric becomes covered in dust.
Someone drops a pebble into a pond. The water surface turns into dry pavement.
A person brushes crumbs from a plate. The plate fills with fresh crumbs.
